responsibility: This implementation file provides the global state and reporting hook for GCC’s fixed-size allocation-pool subsystem. It owns the pool allocator statistics objects and pool ID sequencing used by alloc-pool.h templates, and emits per-pool memory-usage reports through dump_alloc_pool_statistics once collection of mem-stats data is enabled.
same_name_distinction: Defines the alloc-pool subsystem’s shared out-of-line state and reporting entry point—such as last_id, pool_allocator_usage, after_memory_report, and dump_alloc_pool_statistics—whereas gcc/alloc-pool.h contains the allocator templates and inline pool operations that clients instantiate.
